label: D2 late in episode, after an unrewarded a1->S1 (common) trial
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only late in the episode (no activity before trial ~60, most at trials 80-99), when the previous trial was a1 -> S1 (common) and went unrewarded (prev_reward 0). It fires mostly when the agent repeated a1 on the current trial (88% of mass has in_action=a1), and the largest activations come on a1 trials, including rare a1->S2 transitions. Model value is low (<7.1) whenever it fires. It is silent at D1/GO, after rewarded trials, and after a2 or rare-transition previous trials. Dev scores: F1 0.64, mass recall 0.76. Requiring the current action to be a1 raises precision a little (0.73) but lowers recall. Misses are mainly window-start trials whose previous trial is unknown, plus weak activations in other histories. Every variable in the predicate is already observed at D2.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (D2: a1 S1 u, a1 S1 r, ?) and trial before (D2: a1 S1 u, a2 S1 r, ?); timing cues that raise it most: phase=D2 & ep_dec=8, phase=D2 & ep_dec=9, phase=D2 & ep_dec=7.
